about: The SecuRAX design standard as data (doc 100): the premium language every page shares (since the owner's yes, 2026-11-10) and the rules a test checks. Change a value here; governance/design.py carries it to every generated page, and governance/tests/test_design_standard.py fails until hand-written pages agree.

premium.about: The premium language (design-premium-language, 2026-11-09): obsidian and ivory, one gold accent used like leaf, a display serif with a calm sans. Every page uses it: generated pages through design.css() or design.premium_css(), hand-written pages by carrying the same values. Each colour pair is AA in both themes (test_design_standard.py measures them).

contrast_more.about: When the person asks for more contrast (prefers-contrast: more): secondary text near ink, hairlines become edges.

buttons.about: Three kinds, one primary per screen. Primary: solid action colour with a leaf rim. Secondary: outlined with --edge (3:1 against every surface, WCAG 1.4.11). Tertiary: an underlined text link. Every button has pressed, busy (aria-busy), done and disabled states; a suggestion is never primary and never acts by itself.

corners.how: progressive: corner-shape where the browser supports it (Chromium 139+), plain rounded corners elsewhere

never.why: dark grey, never pure black: obsidian is a surface accent, not the page

type.numbers_where: on numbers only (.num, data, time, table figures), never the whole body: some sans fonts widen the hyphen too

glass.about: Frosted glass for layers that float over scrolling content only. Opaque enough (92%) to stay legible even where blur is not rendered (old phones, battery saver), so blur adds depth, never legibility: sticky bars, the bottom tab bar, sheets and dialogs. Never page sections or cards (glass on a flat page is just grey). At most three glass layers on screen; a solid fallback where blur is unsupported or the person asks for less transparency.

haptics.about: Hooks only: an element with data-haptic='tap|success|warn' asks design.haptic(); nothing fires under reduced motion or where the device has no vibration.

gold-leaf.means: money and career; the Professional edition

cues: Restraint is the luxury: one thing to do per screen, the rest folded or gone.
Type carries the brand: a serif for the few words that matter, a quiet sans for everything else, figures that line up.
Colour is a jewel, not paint: neutrals everywhere, gold only on the one action or mark that earns it.
Material over decoration: hairlines, soft depth, a lit rim; never a flat grey box or a stock picture.
Motion confirms, never performs: short, eased, only on a change of state, and gone when asked.
Copy like a concierge: short, warm, certain; no exclamation marks, no jargon.
Fast is premium: the first screen is useful in under a second, offline.

rules.contrast: WCAG 2.2 AA, both themes, measured by guiding-map/tests/ui_audit.py
